trace.query: How can I apply online for completion of an INC grade?
trace.answer_for_eval: To apply online for the completion of an INC (Incomplete) grade at LSPU-LB, visit the official university website and look for the student portal or online services section. Follow the instructions provided for grade completion requests. If unavailable online, contact the registrar's office for guidance.
